messages.subject: updatenumericInput - is this a bug?
parts:
I am trying to use updateNumericInput in my app, and it is not behaving as expected.  I can change the value in the numeric input box in the app, but the apparent value as used further on in my app ignores the changed value.

My app loads a shapefile from the user, and the user changes a parameter, a number of points to be calculated, in a numeric input.  After I determine a set of points on a given dataset (which is a reactive function), I use updateNumericInput to reset the number of points to zero, in an attempt to prevent the app from immediately calculating the prior number of points if a new file is uploaded.  I WANT the app to retain the reset, 0, value I just set.  However, upn upload of a new dataset, the app merrily re-calculates the points, instead.   The code does not even wait for the submit button to be pressed, that I've coded! 

I don't know why I am getting this behavior,  and I didn't think this was what ought to happen?  PLEASE take a look at these excerpts of my code:

ui.R:

tabPanel("Plot",  
               numericInput("pts", "# of sampling points per stratum:", 0),
               numericInput("oversamppts", "# to OVER sample (optional):", 0),
               submitButton("Generate Points"),
              

server.R:

mySHPdata <- reactive({
   
    x<- 0
    updateNumericInput(session, "pts", value = x)
    updateNumericInput(session, "oversamppts", value = x)
    inFile <- input$file1
    if (is.null(inFile))
      return(NULL)
    # unzipping upload is a sys call and depends on platform
  <snipped>
      ...
    return (
     readOGR(dirname(inFile$datapath), shapename)
     )
    })

grtsPointData <- reactive({
      if(input$pts == 0)
        return(NULL)
 <snipped>
...
 result <- grts2(design=as.list(wholedesign), src.frame="sp.object", sp.object=theSHP, type.frame="area",
                   stratum="strata", id="ID",
                     att.frame=test.attframe,
                     prjfilename="rgdaltest2",
                     out.shape="grtstest")
      x<- 0
      updateNumericInput(session, "pts", value = x)
      updateNumericInput(session, "oversamppts", value = x)
      return(result)
    })   
   
.. I have also tried adding an observer (as I saw that in an example) as follows:

observe({
    x <- input$controller
    })
  
that did not help.

Can someone please advise me or tell me what I need to read/understand.  Thank you.

messages.subject: Re: updatenumericInput - is this a bug?
parts:
See http://glimmer.rstudio.com/stla/Isolate_example1/

The app will access the new input$file whenever a reactive element inside the body of your reactive function will change.
